verdict.rationale: Only evidence is that pressing the Super key opens a search-based launcher (fedora-docs-6), which supports the 'launcher' part of the story, but there is no documentation of comprehensive keyboard-only workflows, window-management hotkeys, or full system control without a mouse. missing for 10: keyboard shortcut reference for window tiling/switching, documentation of full keyboard-driven workflows, independent confirmation that GNOME can be used entirely without a mouse.
